stem: A model of weekly soundbar units was fitted on weeks with prices between €180 and €260. The category manager wants its prediction for a price of €90. What is the main risk?

options.text: €90 is far outside the prices seen, so the line may not hold there
None, since a linear model holds at any price once it is fitted
The prediction will be too low, because the intercept ignores display
The model's R² will be negative at prices below €100
